reason: An orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness that isolates coding tasks in Git worktrees, supports testing and review, and provides user-controlled preview, rollback, commit, and cleanup workflows.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Git Worktree 的隔离编码会话、任务验收预览、回滚、提交和清理流程。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with isolated Git worktree coding sessions and user-controlled review, preview, rollback, commit, and cleanup workflows.

capabilities: Creates and manages isolated Git worktrees and Harness sessions
Allows agent-driven file modification and project verification within isolated workspaces
Synchronizes task changes to a Local preview
Supports user-controlled rollback, commit finalization, discard, and worktree cleanup
